entries.en: Archers are a class of great accuracy and strength, using their powerful skills with bows to deal extraordinary damage from range. Much like wizards, they rely on their keen instincts to dodge oncoming attacks as they tend to leave themselves open to frontal attacks. However, their physical prowess and deadly aim allows them to instil fear into anyone they hit.
entries.zh-TW: 弓箭手是精準度和力量都很高的職業，利用弓箭的強大技能可以在遠距離造成驚人的傷害。與法師類似，他們依靠敏銳的直覺來躲避來襲攻擊，因為正面攻擊容易讓他們暴露。然而，他們強大的體能和致命的準度使得被命中的目標心生畏懼。
entries.pt-BR: Os Arqueiros são uma classe de grande precisão e força, que usa suas poderosas habilidades com o arco para causar um dano extraordinário à distância. Assim como os Magos, contam com seus instintos aguçados para desviar dos ataques que se aproximam, já que costumam ficar expostos a ataques frontais. Mesmo assim, sua aptidão física e mira letal lhes permitem incutir medo em qualquer um que atingem.
aliases: Archers are a class of great accuracy and strength, using their powerful skills with bows to deal extraordinary damage from range. Much like wizards, they rely on their keen instincts to dodge oncoming attacks as they tend to leave themselves open to frontal attacks. However, their physical prowess and deadly aim allows them to instil fear into anyone they hit.
弓箭手是精准度和力量都很高的职业，利用弓箭的强大技能可以在远距离造成惊人的伤害。与法师类似，他们依靠敏锐的直觉来躲避来袭攻击，因为正面攻击容易让他们暴露。然而，他们强大的体能和致命的准度使得被命中的目标心生畏惧。

entries.en: Assassins are members of a secret organization and their history is relatively unknown. They're capable of hiding themselves and performing attacks while being unseen by others, which naturally makes them excellent at making fast kills. It is necessary for them to avoid being in battles with multiple enemies due to their weak vitality and strength.
entries.zh-TW: 刺客是秘密組織的成員，他們的歷史較為神秘。他們能夠隱藏自身並在不被他人察覺的情況下發動攻擊，這天生讓他們擅長快速擊殺目標。由於生命力和力量較弱，他們必須避免與多個敵人作戰。
entries.pt-BR: Os Assassinos são membros de uma organização secreta e sua história é relativamente desconhecida. São capazes de se ocultar e atacar sem serem vistos pelos demais, o que naturalmente os torna excelentes em abates rápidos. Precisam evitar batalhas contra vários inimigos devido à sua baixa vitalidade e força.

entries.en: Taoists are well disciplined in the study of Astronomy, Medicine, and others aside from Mu-Gong. Rather then directly engaging the enemies, their specialty lies in assisting their allies with support. Taoists can summon powerful creatures and have a high resistance to magic, and is a class with well balanced offensive and defensive abilities.
entries.zh-TW: 道士在天文、醫術以及除武功之外的其他領域上都有嚴格修煉。他們的特長不在於直接與敵人交戰，而是通過輔助來支援盟友。道士能夠召喚強大的生物，並且具有很高的魔法抗性，是攻防能力均衡的職業。
entries.pt-BR: Os Taoístas são bem disciplinados no estudo da Astronomia, da Medicina e de outras artes além do Mu-Gong. Em vez de enfrentar os inimigos diretamente, sua especialidade está em apoiar seus aliados com suporte. Os Taoístas podem invocar criaturas poderosas e possuem alta resistência à magia, sendo uma classe com habilidades ofensivas e defensivas bem equilibradas.
aliases: Taoists are well disciplined in the study of Astronomy, Medicine, and others aside from Mu-Gong. Rather then directly engaging the enemies, their specialty lies in assisting their allies with support. Taoists can summon powerful creatures and have a high resistance to magic, and is a class with well balanced offensive and defensive abilities.

entries.en: Warriors are a class of great strength and vitality. They are not easily killed in battle and have the advantage of being able to use a variety of heavy weapons and Armour. entries.en: Wizards are a class of low strength and stamina, but have the ability to use powerful spells. Their offensive spells are very effective, but because it takes time to cast these spells, they're likely to leave themselves open for enemy's attacks. Therefore, the physically weak wizards must aim to attack their enemies from a safe distance.
